document.summary: The new endpoint skips the authorization check the rest of the controller relies on, so a signed-in user can reach another tenant's data.

findings.title: The tenant ownership check the sibling actions apply is missing from the new run action
findings.scenario: A request that supplies another tenant's run identifier reaches this action without the ownership check the sibling actions apply, and the handler reads and returns that run.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can read another tenant's review results by guessing or enumerating identifiers.
findings.action: Apply the same tenant-ownership check the sibling actions use before the run is loaded.
findings.explanation: The new action loads the run by identifier alone, with no policy or scope check tying it to the requesting user's tenant.
